1.english_reference: The earth [ is ] the LORD’S , and the fulness thereof ;

traditions.WLC: לַֽ֭ יהוָה הָ אָ֣רֶץ וּ מְלוֹאָ֑ הּ

traditions.VUL: Dómini est terra , et plenitúdo eius :
traditions.KJV: The earth [ is ] the LORD’S , and the fulness thereof ;

1.english_reference: the world , and they that dwell therein .

traditions.LXX: ἡ οἰκουμένη καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ .
traditions.VUL: orbis terrárum , et univérsi qui hábitant in eo .
traditions.KJV: the world , and they that dwell therein .

2.english_reference: For he hath founded it upon the seas

traditions.WLC: כִּי ה֭וּא עַל יַמִּ֣ים יְסָדָ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς ἐπὶ θαλασσῶν ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτήν ,
traditions.VUL: Quia ipse super mária fundávit eum ,
traditions.KJV: For he hath founded it upon the seas ,

2.english_reference: and established it upon the floods

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ ποταμῶν ἡτοίμασεν αὐτήν .
traditions.KJV: and established it upon the floods .

3.english_reference: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD ?

traditions.LXX: τίς ἀναβήσεται εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ κυρίου ,
traditions.KJV: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD ?

3.english_reference: or who shall stand in his holy place ?

traditions.WLC: וּ מִי יָ֝קוּם בִּ מְק֥וֹם קָדְשֽׁ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τίς στήσεται ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ ;
traditions.VUL: aut quis stabit in loco sancto eius ?
traditions.KJV: or who shall stand in his holy place ?

4.english_reference: He that hath clean hands , and a pure heart

traditions.LXX: ἀθῷος χερσὶν καὶ καθαρὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ ,
traditions.KJV: He that hath clean hands , and a pure heart ;

4.english_reference: who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא נָשָׂ֣א לַ שָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑ י
traditions.LXX: ὃς οὐκ ἔλαβεν ἐπὶ ματαίῳ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: qui non accépit in vano ánimam suam ,
traditions.KJV: who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ὤμοσεν ἐπὶ δόλῳ τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: nec iurávit in dolo próximo suo .
traditions.KJV: nor sworn deceitfully .

5.english_reference: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD

traditions.LXX: οὗτος λήμψεται εὐλογίαν παρὰ Κυρίου ,
traditions.KJV: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD ,

5.english_reference: and righteousness from the God of his salvation

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ צְדָקָ֗ה מֵ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλεημοσύνην παρὰ θεοῦ σωτῆρος αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et misericórdiam a Deo salutári suo .
traditions.KJV: and righteousness from the God of his salvation .

6.english_reference: This [ is ] the generation of them that seek him

traditions.LXX: αὕτη ἡ γενεὰ ζητούντων αὐτόν ,
traditions.KJV: This [ is ] the generation of them that seek him ,

6.english_reference: that seek thy face , O Jacob

traditions.LXX: ζητούντων τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ θεοῦ Ἰακώβ .
traditions.KJV: that seek thy face , O Jacob .

traditions.LXX: διάψαλμα .
traditions.KJV: Selah .

7.english_reference: Lift up your heads , O ye gates

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάρθητε , πύλαι αἰώνιοι ,
